subject.title: [Feature Request] Add tool call visibility to streamTo="parent" for ACP runtime

question: Should ACP `streamTo="parent"` expose tool-call/tool-result/thinking progress to parent sessions, and what default, verbosity, and redaction contract should govern that exposure?
rationale: The requested data can include tool parameters, command output, file contents, and reasoning text, so code inspection alone cannot choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve a bounded opt-in projection
options.body: Expose only summarized and redacted ACP tool/status/thinking progress through the existing tag-visibility/progress pipeline, with tests for default-hidden behavior.

options.title: Defer raw tool and thinking visibility
options.body: Keep current assistant/commentary/status behavior and require a narrower proposal for each sensitive event class before implementation.

options.title: Reject parent raw forwarding
options.body: Document that raw ACP tool results and thinking stay in logs or dedicated diagnostic surfaces rather than parent chat streams.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded opt-in projection
recommendation.body: Expose only summarized and redacted ACP tool/status/thinking progress through the existing tag-visibility/progress pipeline, with tests for default-hidden behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the closest prior visibility-policy change for opt-in ACP parent commentary/status progress.
